CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What should you do after crossing the finish line? (1 mark)
   A. Slow down gradually
   B. Stop suddenly
   C. Turn around fast
   D. Push others

2. At the set position, the hips are (1 mark)
   A. behind the line only
   B. lower than the knees
   C. on the ground
   D. a little higher than the shoulders

3. The top stripe of the Kenyan flag is (1 mark)
   A. red
   B. green
   C. white
   D. black

4. On the Kenyan flag, black stands for (1 mark)
   A. the land
   B. the sea
   C. the people of Kenya
   D. peace

5. Why do we warm up before gymnastics? (1 mark)
   A. To learn songs
   B. To make us tired
   C. To prepare the muscles and joints
   D. To make the mat softer

6. In which direction should a side roll travel? (1 mark)
   A. Round and round in place
   B. In a straight line along the mat
   C. In a curve off the mat
   D. Backwards over your head

7. If your head drops back with a strain in the crab balance, you should (1 mark)
   A. close your mouth tight
   B. hold your breath
   C. throw it back further
   D. keep the head in line and look gently up

8. Which quality do rolls and balances build? (1 mark)
   A. Loud singing
   B. Balance and coordination
   C. Colour mixing
   D. Reading speed

9. In a folk song, the singer who leads is called the (1 mark)
   A. listener
   B. soloist
   C. umpire
   D. drummer

10. A song that is played fast has a (1 mark)
   A. low pitch
   B. fast tempo
   C. long title
   D. soft dynamic

11. A sign that narrows to the right means (1 mark)
   A. getting faster
   B. getting softer
   C. getting louder
   D. repeat

12. What does good diction mean? (1 mark)
   A. Clapping
   B. Singing with no words
   C. Saying the words clearly
   D. Singing very loudly

13. Photography is (1 mark)
   A. the art of taking pictures with a camera
   B. singing songs
   C. painting with a brush
   D. cutting paper

14. Which is a digital device for photography? (1 mark)
   A. Kayamba
   B. Smartphone
   C. Ruler
   D. Recorder

15. Who should you ask before using a school digital device? (1 mark)
   A. A teacher or adult
   B. A friend's pet
   C. A stranger
   D. Nobody

16. The lens of a camera (1 mark)
   A. lets light in
   B. keeps it cool
   C. gives power
   D. stores photos

17. Where should the mouthpiece rest? (1 mark)
   A. Between your lips, not your teeth
   B. Between your teeth
   C. Behind your ear
   D. On your chin

18. Where is the thumb hole? (1 mark)
   A. At the back
   B. On the bell
   C. On the mouthpiece
   D. Under the foot

19. Of the notes B, A and G, which is the highest? (1 mark)
   A. G
   B. B
   C. A
   D. They are equal

20. When you blow into the recorder, the sound is made by (1 mark)
   A. a string
   B. air vibrating inside it
   C. a drum skin
   D. the wood being struck

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Describe how to blow to make a good tone. (3 marks)

22. Give four safety rules for sprint races. (4 marks)

23. Why should you delete poor photographs from a device? (3 marks)

24. Give three common mistakes in the crab balance and how to fix them. (3 marks)

25. Why do we get up slowly after a side roll? (3 marks)

26. Explain how the elongated start is different from the medium start. (4 marks)

27. Describe the position of the back knee in the medium start and in the elongated start. (3 marks)

28. Describe a sequence that joins the crab balance and the side roll, and how to perform it safely. (5 marks)

29. State the three commands at the start of a sprint race in order. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #2 (TERM 2) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. A — Slow down gradually
   Slowing down gradually is safer.

2. D — a little higher than the shoulders
   On set the hips lift slightly above the shoulders.

3. D — black
   Black is at the top, red in the middle and green at the bottom.

4. C — the people of Kenya
   Black represents the people of Kenya.

5. C — To prepare the muscles and joints
   A warm body is less likely to be injured.

6. B — In a straight line along the mat
   Rolling in a straight line keeps you on the mat.

7. D — keep the head in line and look gently up
   Keep the head in line with the body.

8. B — Balance and coordination
   Gymnastics teaches the body to stay steady and move parts together.

9. B — soloist
   The soloist sings the lead part.

10. B — fast tempo
   Tempo is speed.

11. B — getting softer
   A closing sign means the music grows softer.

12. C — Saying the words clearly
   Clear words help the audience understand the message.

13. A — the art of taking pictures with a camera
   A photograph is a picture taken by a camera.

14. B — Smartphone
   A smartphone has a camera lens and digital memory.

15. A — A teacher or adult
   Always get permission.

16. A — lets light in
   The lens gathers light for the picture.

17. A — Between your lips, not your teeth
   Lips form the seal.

18. A — At the back
   The left thumb covers the hole at the back.

19. B — B
   Fewer covered holes give a higher note.

20. B — air vibrating inside it
   The air inside vibrates.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: Put the mouthpiece between the lips, take a deep breath, blow gently and steadily, and start each note with a soft too or doo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

22. (4 marks)
   Answer: Run in your own lane; check the track for stones; wear proper clothes; never push or trip; slow down gradually after the finish; warm up. Any four.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.

23. (3 marks)
   Answer: To save memory space, keep only good pictures and make it easier to find the best ones.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Hips sagging: push harder. Bent arms: straighten them. Head dropped: keep it in line.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each mistake with a fix.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: Getting up fast can make you feel dizzy and you may fall. Slowly is safer.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for dizziness, 1 mark for falling, 1 mark for safety.

26. (4 marks)
   Answer: The rear knee is placed further back, level with the heel of the front foot. The feet are further apart. The push is longer and stronger but may feel less steady.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid difference or explanation, up to 4.

27. (3 marks)
   Answer: In the medium start, the back knee is level with the middle of the front foot. In the elongated start it is level with the heel of the front foot.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each position, 1 mark for saying the elongated start is further back.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: Warm up and use a mat with a clear space. Do a crab balance and hold for three counts. Lower to the mat and lie straight with arms overhead. Do a side roll in a straight line. Get up slowly and finish standing tall.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark each for safety, crab balance, lowering, roll, and finish.

29. (2 marks)
   Answer: On your marks, set, go.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for all three, 1 mark for the correct order.
